summary: CWE-581 (Object Model Violation): the bad class overrides hashCode() but does not override equals(). Per the Java object contract, any class that overrides hashCode() must also override equals() so that equal objects produce equal hash codes. I added an equals() implementation consistent with the existing hashCode() (which is based on the message and seed fields), preserving the message-setting feature.
